name: nulnul-harness
description: Complete project outcomes by selecting task-fit, evidence-backed capabilities, verifying the work, and removing only what does not materially help.

interface.longDescription: Describe the outcome. nulnul harness inspects the project, selects the strongest justified task-fit capability path within safety, permission, and cost boundaries, verifies the work, and removes additions that do not materially help. Personal adaptations and evolution remain compatibility-checked behind independent Gates.
defaultPrompt: Build this project with the strongest justified task-fit capabilities, verify the result, and remove anything that does not materially help.
Turn this recurring workflow into a verified automation; add capability only for material outcome value and remove non-contributing parts.
Continue this project from verified state, choose outcome-competitive capabilities, and independently verify any harness change.
